exposure: in vitro fertilisation of donated embryos
cohort: A 66-year-old woman who underwent in vitro fertilisation of donated embryos and experienced a high-risk pregnancy.
finding: The case details the clinical course and management of a pregnancy in a 66-year-old woman, highlighting the obstetric implications and adverse maternal outcomes including pre-eclampsia, caesarean section, and later diagnosis of ovarian cancer leading to death.
mod_finding: A caesarean section was performed at 33 weeks gestation due to the development of pre-eclampsia.
